name: Smithing Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Craft (blacksmithing) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Master Smith (Ex)

You can use your ranks in Craft (blacksmithing) in lieu of Craft (armor) or Craft (weapons), provided the item forged is primarily made of metal. You can craft mundane metal items quickly, using half their gp value to determine progress. If you have the requisite feats, you can also craft magical metal items in half the normal amount of time. When you use a normal metal weapon, armor, shield, or tool that you have forged yourself, that item is treated as if it were a masterwork item.

When you use a masterwork metal tool that you have forged yourself, that item provides a +3 skill bonus instead of the normal +2 bonus. When you use a masterwork metal weapon, armor, or shield that you have forged yourself, that item is treated as if it had a +1 enhancement bonus; this bonus stacks with any enhancement bonus you may have already bestowed on the item if you can craft magic items, to a maximum enhancement bonus of +5. Regardless of the item, only you can benefit from the added bonus that your mastery provides.

Associated Technique
Craftsman’s Technique (Ex)

When you use this technique, any manufactured weapon you wield overcomes DR/magic against the target you have studied with this ability. If you are at least 5th level, it also overcomes DR/silver and DR/cold iron. If you are at least 11th level, it also overcomes any kind of alignment DR, such as DR/evil or DR/lawful. If you are at least 16th level, it also overcomes DR/adamantine. If you are 20th level, it also overcomes DR/epic. Note that these benefits do not apply to unarmed strikes or natural attacks—only to manufactured weapons.

Advanced Study Abilities
Hand of the Forge (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Master Smith study ability, scholar level 7th.

You can expend 1 point of inspiration to instantly repair or destroy a metal object within 30 feet. If you repair it, the object is restored 1d6 hit points per 2 ranks that you possess in Craft (metalsmithing); this otherwise functions as make whole. If you choose to destroy the object, it instead takes 1d6+1 points of damage per 2 ranks that you possess in Craft (metalsmithing); hardness applies. If the object is magical or in a creature’s possession, the item (or its attending creature) can make a Fortitude save to halve the damage. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day when you reach 12 and 17 ranks in Craft (blacksmithing).

Heart of the Forge (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Master Smith study ability, scholar level 3rd.

Your long hours at the forge provide you with increased resilience. You gain a number of bonus hit points equal to your number of ranks in Craft (blacksmithing).

Soul of the Forge (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Master Smith study ability, scholar level 2nd.

From forging weapons, you have better learned to use them. Choose any one type of (primarily) metal weapon that you are proficient with, such as a blade or a mace.

You gain Weapon Focus with that weapon.

When you reach 6 ranks in Craft (blacksmithing), you also gain Weapon Specialization with that weapon. When you reach 11 ranks in Craft (blacksmithing), you also gain Improved Critical with that weapon.

Tricks of the Forge (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Master Smith study ability, scholar level 5th.

You can duplicate any one of the following weapon special properties and add it to a metal weapon by spending one minute working on it and expending 1 point of inspiration: grounding, impervious, keen, neutralizing, reliable, or thawing. If you have at least 8 ranks in Craft (blacksmithing) and expend 2 points of inspiration, you can instead imbue the weapon with the impact or wounding special property. Only one property can be added to any weapon; the weapon must be of a type suitable for the effect granted (for example, you could only grant the reliable quality to a firearm), and the effect lasts for 1 hour. This is considered an extraordinary effect, not a magical one. It stacks with any other special qualities the weapon may already have except the one it duplicates.
